// A planar blob system: the field value at a point is the summed influence
// of all balls minus Threshold, so the zero level set is the blob outline.
type MetaBallSystem2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Balls: Array<MetaBall2D>;
    Threshold: Number;
}

// A spatial blob system: the field value at a point is the summed influence
// of all balls minus Threshold, so the zero level set is the blob surface.
type MetaBallSystem3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Balls: Array<MetaBall3D>;
    Threshold: Number;
}

//==
// # SDF modifiers
//
// Parameter records for standard distance-field transformations. Each
// describes how a source SDF is reshaped; the source itself is supplied by
// the evaluation context. The functions that apply them live in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// Rounds sharp edges and corners by subtracting Radius from the distance,
// inflating the shape and smoothing its features.
type SdfRoundingModifier
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Number;
}

// Replaces a solid with its shell: the region within half of Thickness on
// either side of the original surface.
type SdfShellModifier
    implements IValue
{
    Thickness: Number;
}

// Replaces a solid with Count concentric shells spaced by Thickness, like
// the layers of an onion. Count of 1 is equivalent to a single shell.
type SdfOnionModifier
    implements IValue
{
    Thickness: Number;
    Count: Integer;
}

// Stretches a planar shape by splitting it at the origin and inserting a
// straight section of the given extent along each axis.
type SdfElongationModifier2D
    implements IValue
{
    Amount: Vector2D;
}

// Stretches a spatial shape by splitting it at the origin and inserting a
// straight section of the given extent along each axis.
type SdfElongationModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Amount: Vector3D;
}

// Tiles a planar shape on a lattice with the given period per axis. Counts
// bounds the repetitions per axis; a non-positive count means unbounded
// repetition along that axis.
type SdfRepetitionModifier2D
    implements IValue
{
    Period: Vector2D;
    Counts: IntegerVector2;
}

// Tiles a spatial shape on a lattice with the given period per axis. Counts
// bounds the repetitions per axis; a non-positive count means unbounded
// repetition along that axis.
type SdfRepetitionModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Period: Vector3D;
    Counts: IntegerVector3;
}

// Twists a spatial shape about the Z axis: each horizontal slice rotates by
// AnglePerUnit times its height.
type SdfTwistModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    AnglePerUnit: Angle;
}

// Bends a spatial shape about the Y axis with the given curvature (turning
// angle per unit of length along X); 0 leaves the shape unchanged.
type SdfBendModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Curvature: Number;
}

// Displaces a surface by a scalar field: Source indexes a caller-supplied
// list of spatial scalar fields whose value, scaled by Amplitude, offsets
// the distance. The result is NOT a bound — adding the displacement inflates
// distances as readily as it shrinks them; `ApplyToDistance` in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` carries the factor that recovers a lower bound.
type SdfDisplacementModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Source: ItemIndex;
    Amplitude: Number;
}

//==
// # Sampled signed distance fields
//
// Discretized SDFs: distance values on a regular lattice over a bounding
// region, interpolated between samples on evaluation. The interpolating
// evaluators live in `implicit-sdf.library.plato`; the lattice
// geometry accessors in `fields-implicits.library.plato`.

// A planar SDF discretized on a regular lattice spanning Bounds. Values holds
// one signed distance per lattice node, in row-major column/row order;
// evaluation between nodes interpolates bilinearly. Implements the bounded
// SDF interface: Bounds are the lattice domain (finite support), not merely
// a culling hint.
type SampledSdf2D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Values: Array2D<Number>;
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
}

// A spatial SDF discretized on a regular lattice spanning Bounds. Values holds
// one signed distance per lattice node, in column/row/layer order; evaluation
// between nodes interpolates trilinearly. Implements the bounded SDF interface:
// Bounds are the lattice domain (finite support).
type SampledSdf3D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D
{
    Values: Array3D<Number>;
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
}
